description_en: Queries the information about a backup job
name: DescribeBackupJob

parameters.help_en:
The instance ID.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/86911.html operation to query the information about all AnalyticDB for PostgreSQL instances within a region, including instance IDs
parameters.help_zh:
实例ID。

您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/86911.html接口查看目标地域下所有的AnalyticDB PostgreSQL版实例的详情，包括实例ID
parameters.name: db_instance_id

BackupId.description_en:
The backup set ID.

You can call the [DescribeDataBackups]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/210093.html） operation to query the IDs of all backup sets in the instance
BackupId.description_zh:
备份集ID。

您可以调用[DescribeDataBackups]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/210093.html）查看目标实例下所有备份集的备份集ID

BackupMode.description_en:
The backup mode. Valid values:

Automated
Manual
BackupMode.description_zh:
备份模式。取值说明：
Automated：系统自动备份
Manual：手动备份

BackupStatus.description_en:
The backup status. Valid values:

schedule
check
backup
finish
BackupStatus.description_zh:
备份状态。取值说明：
schedule：初始化中
check：检查中
backup：备份中
finish：已完成

Process.description_en: The progress of the backup job

StartTime.description_en: The time when the backup job started. The time follows the ISO 8601 standard in the YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ssZ format. The time is displayed in UTC
StartTime.description_zh: 备份任务开始时间（UTC），格式为YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ssZ
